name: framework-upgrade-copilot
description: Plans and guides major framework upgrades one hop at a time for Rails (6.1 to 8.1), Laravel (10 to 13) and Django (4.2 LTS to 6.0): detects versions from lock files, lists breaking changes, removed APIs, config defaults, language minimums and a test-gated checklist per hop, with sources from the official upgrade guides
